faqs.q: Do you do emergency call-outs? | 24 hour plumber | can you come tonight | out of hours
faqs.a: Yes, we do emergency call-outs evenings, nights and weekends. Call us and we'll get someone to you as soon as possible.

faqs.q: Do you give free quotes? | do you charge for quotes | free estimate
faqs.a: Yes, quotes are free for bigger jobs like bathrooms and replacements. For repairs we charge the call-out fee, which includes the first 30 minutes of work.

faqs.q: Are you insured? | licensed | certified | qualified
faqs.a: Yes, we're fully qualified and insured, and all our work is guaranteed.

faqs.q: Do you guarantee your work? | warranty | guarantee
faqs.a: Yes, all our repairs come with a 12-month guarantee on labour.

faqs.q: How do I pay? | payment methods | card | cash | bizum | transfer
faqs.a: You can pay by card, cash or bank transfer when the job is done.

faqs.q: How soon can you come? | earliest appointment | when can you come | today
faqs.a: We can usually come the same or next working day. For emergencies, call us and we'll come as soon as possible.

faqs.q: Do you install bathrooms? | bathroom renovation | new shower | walk in shower
faqs.a: Yes, we fit complete bathrooms and showers. We'll visit to measure and give you a free quote.

faqs.q: Where is my stopcock? | turn off the water | shut off valve | main valve
faqs.a: The main stopcock is usually under the kitchen sink, near the water meter, or where the water pipe enters the building. Turn it clockwise to shut off the water.

emergencies.keywords: burst pipe | flooding | flood | water everywhere | water leaking through ceiling | water coming through ceiling | tuberia rota | inundacion
emergencies.message: Turn off the water at the main stopcock straight away (usually under the kitchen sink or by the water meter). If water is near sockets or light fittings, switch off the electricity at the fuse box if you can do it safely. Then call us now.

emergencies.keywords: smell gas | gas smell | gas leak | huele a gas | fuga de gas
emergencies.message: If you smell gas: don't switch anything on or off, no flames or smoking. Open doors and windows, turn off the gas at the meter if you can do it safely, then leave the building and call the gas emergency line or your local emergency number from outside.
